documents.homeCareFooter: If you have questions or it gets worse, call us: {phone}
documents.homeCareGreeting: Hello {owner}, here are the instructions for {pet} after the visit on {date}:
documents.consentText:
BASIC DATA PROTECTION INFORMATION

Controller: {clinic} (NIF {nif}), {address}.
Purpose: veterinary care of your pet, appointments, medical records, billing and, if you allow it, reminders and communications.
Legal basis: providing the service you request, legal obligations (health and tax) and your consent for the optional messages.
Recipients: data is not shared with third parties except where the law requires it (e.g. official animal or veterinary prescription registers) and providers of technical services to us.
Retention: for as long as the relationship lasts and the periods the law requires.
Your rights: access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability, and withdrawing consent at any time, by writing to {email}. You may also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
documents.reminderVaccine: Hello {owner}, a reminder that {pet} is due for the {vaccine} vaccine on {date}. Shall we book an appointment? {contact}
documents.reminderAppointment: Hello {owner}, a reminder of {pet}'s appointment on {date} at {time}. If you can't come, please let us know. {contact}
documents.consentKind_general: Informed consent for veterinary examination and treatment
documents.consentKind_surgery: Informed consent for surgery, sedation and anaesthesia
documents.consentSignerOwner: {owner} (NIF {nif}), as owner or person responsible for the animals listed below,
documents.consentSignerAuthorised: {signer}, authorised by the owner {owner}, regarding the animals listed below,
documents.consentBody_text_general:
DECLARES that they have been clearly informed about the health of their animal and AUTHORISES the veterinary team of the centre to carry out the examination, diagnostic tests (laboratory, imaging, sampling) and routine treatment considered necessary, including medicines and vaccines.
They have been told that any clinical act may have unforeseeable adverse effects even when performed correctly, and that a specific written consent will be requested before any act with risk (surgery, sedation, anaesthesia, hospitalisation).
The cost of tests and treatment will be given in advance, except in a life-threatening emergency.
This consent may be withdrawn at any time by telling the centre.
documents.consentBody_text_surgery:
DECLARES that the vet has clearly explained the procedure, its purpose, risks and possible complications, the alternatives and the estimated cost, and that they could ask all their questions.
They have been told that any sedation or anaesthesia carries a risk, even in healthy animals, which may include death, and that complications may arise (bleeding, infection, drug reactions, wound opening) that could need further treatment.
AUTHORISES the procedure and the necessary sedation or anaesthesia, as well as the prior tests the vet considers appropriate. If an unforeseen situation arises during the procedure that requires immediate action to save the life of the animal and the signatory cannot be reached, AUTHORISES the vet to take the necessary measures.
Agrees to follow the fasting and aftercare instructions and to pay for the service.
documents.consentBody_text_hospitalization:
DECLARES that they have been informed of the reason for admission, the planned treatment, its approximate length, the risks and the estimated cost.
AUTHORISES the hospitalisation of the animal and the treatment and tests the veterinary team considers necessary during the stay. They will be told of any important change in the condition of the animal or in the cost.
They have been told that, despite care, the condition of the animal may get worse, and that the centre will let them know at once.
Gives a reachable contact phone and agrees to pay for the hospitalisation.
documents.consentBody_text_euthanasia:
DECLARES that they are the owner or the person legally authorised over the animal and freely REQUESTS its euthanasia, having been informed by the vet of the reason, the procedure (prior sedation and euthanasia drug, without pain for the animal) and that it cannot be undone.
DECLARES that the animal has not bitten or scratched any person or animal in the last 14 days.
Chooses the option for the remains stated above and agrees to pay for the service and, if applicable, the cremation.
documents.consentBody_text_necropsy:
AUTHORISES a necropsy of the animal to find the cause of death, the taking of samples and, if needed, sending them to an external laboratory.
They have been told that a necropsy does not always give a final diagnosis, the approximate time for results and the cost.
Chooses the option for the remains stated above.
documents.consentClosing: Signed after reading this document, a copy of which is given to the signatory. In accordance with art. 18 of the Spanish Veterinary Code of Ethics. Personal data is processed according to the data protection information of the centre.
